criteria.question: Did the agent acknowledge the customer's situation and feelings?
criteria.aiInstruction: Yes if the agent explicitly recognises the customer's frustration, urgency or impact before or while solving. Partially if a generic apology only. No if the reply jumps straight to the solution or ignores clear frustration.

criteria.question: Was the tone professional, warm and respectful?
criteria.aiInstruction: No if the reply is curt, dismissive, blaming, pressuring or passive-aggressive. Partially if polite but cold or robotic.

criteria.question: Did the agent correctly understand the customer's issue?
criteria.aiInstruction: Yes if the reply addresses the actual problem the customer described. No if it answers a different question or misses the main ask.

criteria.question: Did the agent resolve the issue or give a concrete, correct solution?
criteria.aiInstruction: Yes if the issue is fixed or the customer has a specific, actionable solution. Partially if the fix is incomplete, vague or leaves part of the request unanswered. No if nothing concrete was done.

criteria.question: Did the agent set clear expectations (what happens next and when)?
criteria.aiInstruction: Yes if the customer knows what happens next with a concrete timeframe (e.g. '3-5 business days', 'tomorrow 9-11'). Partially if next steps are given without a timeframe or with vague wording like 'soon' or 'eventually'. N/A only if the issue was fully resolved in the reply and nothing further will happen.

criteria.question: Was the reply clear, complete and easy to follow?
criteria.aiInstruction: No if the reply is confusing, missing key information the customer needs, or so short it leaves the customer guessing.

criteria.question: Before changing account access, passwords, 2FA, refunds or payment details, did the agent verify the requester's identity?
criteria.aiInstruction: Sensitive actions are ones that move money or escalate account access: resetting a password or sending a reset link, disabling or changing 2FA, changing the account email or phone, changing payment details, and issuing a REFUND at the customer's request. Cancelling or downgrading a subscription is NOT sensitive on its own (no money leaves the account and no access is escalated) unless it is bundled with a refund. Correcting the company's own error (for example reversing a duplicate charge or refunding a late-delivery shipping fee) is NOT sensitive either. Fail if a sensitive action was taken after only asking for the email address, or with no verification at all. Pass if at least one additional factor was checked (e.g. last 4 digits of card or phone, billing zip, last invoice amount). N/A if no sensitive action was taken.

criteria.question: Did the agent avoid exposing passwords or sensitive data in plain text?
criteria.aiInstruction: Fail if the agent wrote a password, full card number or other secret in the reply.

criteria.question: Did the agent go beyond the ask (proactive tip, prevention, personal follow-up, goodwill gesture)?
criteria.aiInstruction: Yes only for something genuinely extra: a prevention tip, a personal follow-up commitment, a goodwill credit, or anticipating the next problem.
